description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Bubble' which extends the 'Image_Graph_Marker_Circle' class. The class is responsible for rendering a bubble marker with a radius proportional to a percentage of the maximum Y value in a graph, used in a graph rendering utility. It includes methods to set the maximum radius and draw the marker.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Bubble
classes.description: A marker class that displays a circle with radius based on a percentage of the maximum Y value, extending the base circle marker.

methods.name: setMaxRadius
methods.description: Sets the maximum radius for the bubble marker that corresponds to 100% Y value.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker on the canvas, calculating the size based on the data value's percentage of the max.
